status: implementation proposal, frozen in the training specification before any fit; reviewed by ChatGPT with the Stage A package

environment.why: transformers, tokenizers and torch equal the accepted evaluation environment's; PEFT and accelerate (Apache-2.0) are the only additions, each released at least two weeks before 11 October 2026

lora.init: PEFT's default (A Kaiming-uniform, B zero) after torch.manual_seed(seed): identical for both direct formats at one seed

schedule.warmup: linear from 0 over ceil(0.05 x total optimizer steps)
schedule.decay: linear to 0 at the last optimizer step

batch.loss: per example: mean cross-entropy over its supervised tokens; each optimizer step averages its examples equally (the last step of an epoch may hold fewer)

precision.attention: eager, as the accepted evaluation runner

context.truncation: none: preparation refuses an example over the limit; nothing is shortened

supervision.direct: the answer letter only: one token, the final prompt position predicting it (the accepted runner scores that position); full-vocabulary cross-entropy
supervision.parser: the semantic string's tokens and the end token <|im_end|>; the prompt is masked

data_order: per epoch, a permutation of the configuration's example keys (sorted) by random.Random(int(SHA-256('a24/order' LF seed LF epoch)[:16], 16)): the same order for both direct formats at one seed

checkpoints.cadence: the end of each epoch (3 per fit)

selection.direct: inner-validation target accuracy over the retained validation rows, by the accepted decision rule (the largest offered final-position logit; an exact tie gives K)
selection.parser: inner-validation resolved-target accuracy over the same retained rows (one decode per parent, resolved in each retained view)
selection.stopping: a fixed 3 epochs; no early stop; every epoch's checkpoint is evaluated
selection.denominator: the retained inner-validation rows: each validation-cohort parent's views whose own check passed (the same rows for the direct formats and the parser); every row counts once (unweighted). A2.6's N/n estimators are not used for the inner validation, where some eligible strata have no selected parent

conditions: every planned optimizer step completed with a finite loss
every checkpoint and resume state written and its hashes read back
the inner validation completed for every checkpoint with no technical failure (direct: every forward completed; parser: every decode returned one of the four declared outcomes)
for the parser, the independent reader agrees with the decoder on every completed decode
the merge check passed and the fine-tuned identity verifies
the merged model passes the accepted runner's smoke step through the fine-tuned identity path
continuation.never: accuracy: no configuration or seed is dropped, repeated or replaced for its accuracy

merge.procedure: PEFT merge_and_unload in float32, saved as safetensors with the pinned tokenizer files and the base config

check.what: the adapter-loaded model against the merged model, same checkpoint, same device

parser_prompt.system_message:
Rewrite the command as one query line and reply with nothing else.
Form: TARGET | RELATION | ANCHOR, or TARGET | between | ANCHOR | ANCHOR.
TARGET and ANCHOR: the object's category as the command writes it, then its colour in brackets when the command gives one, for example chair [white].
RELATION: closest N or farthest N, where N is 1, 2 or 3 (closest, second closest, third closest), or near, below or on.
Colours: black, blue, brown, gray, maroon, navy, orange, purple, white, yellow.
parser_prompt.user: the command text, exactly as the derived command record holds it
parser_prompt.categories: not listed: the 893 labels are enforced by the constrained decoder's grammar

analysis.bootstrap: A2.6c's, unchanged: random.Random(20261010), B = 10,000, paired by environment, nearest-rank 95% percentile intervals
analysis.weights: A2.6c's command-weighted (N/n) and environment-weighted estimators over the frozen development benchmark
analysis.seeds: each seed reported with its environment interval; the three seeds' mean (its own environment interval) and their spread (minimum, maximum, standard deviation of the point estimates) reported apart: seed variation is never folded into the environment interval
analysis.supplementary: a coverage diagnostic, specified before any new result and labelled supplementary: each system's accuracy within each of the rules' saved per-row outcomes (A2.6c's rule scores), per view and format; the headline denominators are unchanged; not a causal estimate of the training exclusions

evaluation.direct_primary: each direct configuration's primary, matched comparison is its trained format
evaluation.cross_format: the same run's other-format rows, which the accepted runner's readback requires, are reported only as a predeclared cross-format transfer analysis, labelled as such; a checkpoint's reported format is fixed by its configuration, never chosen after seeing accuracy
evaluation.parser: one decode per parent per selected checkpoint, resolved in both views; reused in comparisons with both direct formats without counting as independent observations
evaluation.partitions: development and legacy reported separately; calibration, test and the lab commands stay closed
